description: Create a new contact (person) or company record. For a person, company_name links them to that company (creating it if needed). Company names must be unique. If assigned_to is omitted, the record is assigned to the API key's own user (one extra GetUser call). Returns { ContactId }. LACRM: CreateContact.

assigned_to.description: UserId to assign the record to. Default: the API key's user.

company_name.description: For a PERSON: the company they work at (created if it does not exist). Not used for company records.

custom_fields.description: Extra fields keyed by the account's field names exactly as LACRM shows them (e.g. {"Lead Source": "Referral"}). Use lacrm_list_custom_fields to find them. Merged verbatim into Parameters.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

is_company.description: true to create a COMPANY record. Default false (a person).

name.description: Full name of the person, or the company's name.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

name: lacrm_create_contact
title: Create a contact or company
